metadata.title: Nvidia has business 'locked up' for a few years — and then things could get thorny - MarketWatch

content.text:
7 min ago
Nvidia has business 'locked up' for a few years — and then things could get thorny
What does Jensen Huang's exit mean for the company's ability to do business going forward?
Nvidia will "continue to perform as usual" in the near term, according to Ryuta Makino, an analyst at Gabelli Funds. That's because deals are "already locked up" for 2027 and potentially even 2028.
However, by 2029 and 2030, business could be impacted, he said in emailed comments.
